topic.title: installation-guide
topic.shortdesc: This guide describes how to install the Z1 Encryption Server on Windows or Linux environments.

section.title: Overview
section.p: The Z1 Encryption Server ensures secure email and file communication within your organization. Before you begin, make sure you have administrator rights on the target system and internet access for license validation.

ul.li: Public IP: Connected to your NLB(network load balance)
